theme: A clear day to close out what's been circling.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan — the day is yours. It's the right one to finally land the travel bookings that keep sliding, and to get set for tomorrow's 9:30 with Amin.

needsAttention.title: December break — pick and book
needsAttention.detail: The book-by date is tomorrow. Settle on a domestic shortlist (nothing to wait on) versus international (refundable only, passports land in November), then book the Dec 13–Jan 2 trip for all four girls.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Flagged p1 and overdue — a full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market. Book it refundable now and fix the dates later.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 Portland-to-St-Pete window closes in four days; book the one hotel night once the drive dates are set.

needsAttention.title: Amin opportunities call
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow at 9:30 you're on Teams with Amin Noorani on new opportunities — line up which board tracks and roles you want in front of him.

flagged.title: ICGN plenary planning call
flagged.detail: Claudia at ICGN is lining up dates for the Plenary 7 planning call, and Rachit replied he's open next week, 12–1 UK. You're cc'd — worth sending your own dates as moderator.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley account funding
flagged.detail: A final reminder to fund your new Signature Savings account before the window closes.

acts.line: The calendar stayed clear — no meetings landed today.
The afternoon is open end to end, a rare stretch to go deep on one thing.
An early start waits tomorrow at 9:30, so an earlier evening earns its keep.
